description: Statutory Authority Hierarchy for Legal & Regulatory Evidentiary Weighting in AyuRaksha

LEVEL_5.name: Primary Authoritative Legislation & Treaties
LEVEL_5.evidentiary_rule: Highest legal precedence. Can never be overridden by secondary commentary or guidelines.

LEVEL_4.name: Official Institutional Guidance & Manuals
examples: IPO Guidelines for Examination of Patent Applications in Traditional Knowledge
NBA Guidelines on Access and Benefit Sharing, 2014
LEVEL_4.evidentiary_rule: Binding on administrative officers but subordinate to parent Acts and Rules.

LEVEL_3.name: Official Standards & Pharmacopoeias
LEVEL_3.evidentiary_rule: Authoritative benchmark for quality, safety, and classical formulation validation.

LEVEL_2.name: Secondary Legal & Scientific Evidence
examples: Published clinical trials on Withania somnifera efficacy
LEVEL_2.evidentiary_rule: Used solely for scientific corroboration or Rule 158B safety proof; cannot establish legal authority.

LEVEL_1.name: Discovery & Contextual Only
LEVEL_1.evidentiary_rule: Strictly excluded from citation generation. Used only for discovery or context.
